cohort_policy: Frozen exact membership; observational [M+H]+, precursor m/z <500, deduplication and scalar-energy compatibility; no precursor-error quality filter
peak_policy: Finite positive peaks, top128 by stable descending intensity, max-intensity normalization, stable ascending m/z, float32
orbitrap_energy_policy: Frozen Option-B single-value compatibility view; source scalar value and actual effective float32 model input retained; no replacement with the narrower initial conversion NCE field
qtof_energy_policy: 500 * scalar energy / precursor_mz; explicit eV or V, title-recovered V under singly charged assumption; float32 model input and unchanged NCE/200 clamp to [0,2]
targets: Included only for evaluation; rebuilding emits no reference formula fields
licensing: Source records retain their per-record licenses. No raw records or peaks redistributed in this bundle.
historical_results: Archived target ranks, retaining failed outputs; arithmetic matches paper-facing tables. No new model inference or accuracy claim.
